name: @ai-km/service-ingestion
comment:pdfjs-dist: Pinned to an EXACT version, no `^` range — same reasoning as services/rag-skeleton's sqlite-vec pin. Stored extracted text is anchored to offsets produced by THIS version's text-join behaviour; a caret range would let `pnpm install` silently move pdfjs-dist underneath already-persisted text/offsets, which is a re-index event, not a patch bump. `extractorVersion` (pdfjs version + our own join-rules version) is persisted with the text for the same reason. User/advisor decision 2026-09-02.
